notes: [P0] outcome: src/main.js never passes the selected kind to draw. The brief says 'main.js passes the selected kind to draw', and the issue says 'the selected kind shows in the HUD'. The 0003.diff only rewords two comments; the draw call is unchanged. render.js now takes draw(ctx, state, hover, sprites = SPRITES, kind = null) and calls drawKind only when kind is given, so in the running game kind stays null and drawKind never runs. The player never sees which tower kind is selected. Fix: change the call in main.js to draw(ctx, state, hover, SPRITES, kind).

[P1] test gap: no test covers the new render paths. Nothing checks that draw calls sprites.drawFrost for a tower with slow > 0, that drawGhost uses THEME.ghostSlowed while slowLeft > 0, or that the HUD shows the kind only when draw is handed one. A test like that would have caught the missing main.js wiring above.

[P2] scope: game.js adds a non-enumerable spawnTimer accessor on the state, used only by the quietGame helper in test/frost.test.js. The test could set state.spawner.timer directly. The accessor adds a second, hidden name for the same field to the game state.

[P2] structure: createTower now puts kind, slow and slowFor on every tower, so lantern and brazier towers carry slow: undefined and slowFor: undefined. Defaulting them the way splash already defaults (slow: kind.slow ?? 0) would keep the tower's fields consistent across kinds.
